doc: Given an entry index idx (s16, sign-extended at entry): tries to register the entry via func_8005A778(D_80084538[idx], idx, D_800847C0[idx]). If that fails (-1), reports status 0x01 for idx via func_8003F52C. Otherwise tries func_8005AAA8(D_80084758[idx], idx); if that succeeds (!=-1), marks entry idx available in D_800847D0.avail (bit 16+idx) and reactivates the subsystem via func_8005AC30(1) (no report). If the retry also fails, cancels the pending entry via func_80055C50(idx) and reports status 0x02 for idx via func_8003F52C. The report word packs: bits 24-31 = 1 (fixed "kind" tag), bits 16-23 = status (1 or 2), bits 8-15 = idx&0xFF, bits 0-7 = 0.
